about: Which points of the map's Launch Sites layer may appear in the public history file (data/history.json), and the only notes they may carry. Read by launch/public.py; checked by tests/test_public.py.
publish: a site appears in the public file only if its name is listed here, under its kind. A site that is not listed is withheld, so a point added to the map later stays out until it is listed.
held: sites that are known and left out on purpose, each with the reason. To publish one, move its name up into 'publish' under the right kind.
Never published, listed or not: a name that reads as a ship (YW-*), and a name that carries a date or a time of day (a position with a time on it is a track point, not a site).

notes: the only free text a site can carry in public, as {"site name": "public note"}. The map's own notes on sites are never copied into the public file. A note here may not contain a speed, a heading, a coordinate or a time of day.
First written 15 Nov 2026 from the site names alone (no note was read). Approved as written, 15 Nov 2026.
